opening.argument: The video presents a structured trading tournament with defined participation requirements and rank-based rewards, not a guaranteed investment return. It advertises “Win 3.5M TREE Tokens,” requires a “Minimum trading requirements (500 USD),” and explains that users who do not meet the threshold receive no reward. The instructions connect eligibility to trading volume and qualifying activity, while the displayed rewards vary by competitive rank. This is an instructional promotion with conditional rewards tied to participation and verified eligibility, rather than a promise of fixed returns. The presentation also makes the commercial relationship transparent: “Some of the links in this video or in the video description may be affiliate links,” while stating that “you are not obligated to use them.”
